commands.summary: 7/7 adversarial test cases passed: 10/10 fault injections verified (right-event/wrong-domain, forged receipts, injected forward hooks, non-finite inputs, inverted endpoints, negative margins, atomic state preservation, recording boundary resets, closed numerical gate, out-of-order backward steps)
214/214 protected files verified clean and intact

requirement_evidence.evidence: Separation of event labels from domain membership strictly verified: query with matching event label but outside domain triggers FALLBACK_NON_MEMBER; query inside domain is admitted purely based on geometric inclusion. Verified by test_c01_zero_label_authorization_and_domain_independence.

Tampered receipt signatures and forged winner labels fail validate_receipt() immediately. Injected forward hooks on module or global torch levels raise UnsupportedGraphError fail-closed. Verified by test_c02_forged_receipts_and_injected_corruption.

Non-finite inputs (NaN/Inf) fail closed in QueryView; inverted bounds in CandidateBox raise ValueError; certificate issuance rejects any non-positive lower margin (is_positive == False). Verified by test_c03_boundary_controls_and_nonfinite_inputs.

Failure during query processing preserves atomic state; last_step_idx, last_recording_id, and counters remain uncorrupted, preventing stale label leakage. Verified by test_c04_atomic_state_commit_under_injected_failure.

Stream continuity strictly enforced: crossing recording boundaries invalidates active certificates and triggers FALLBACK_RECORDING_RESET. Out-of-order backward steps trigger FALLBACK_UNSUPPORTED. Verified by test_c05_stream_continuity_and_boundary_resets.

Ineligible numerical capability profile (formal_reuse_enabled = False) forces 100% fallback to reference model (0 reuse hits) even on identical inputs, proving accepted reuse is strictly guarded by the conjunction of capability, membership, and positive bounds. Verified by test_c06_conjunction_gate_and_ineligible_fallback.

All 10 adversarial checks executed with clean disposable fixtures, zero frozen file mutations. Artifact output/week4/week4_initial_20261103/adversarial_checks.json generated with 100% pass rate. Verified by test_c07_adversarial_checks_artifact_generation.

scientific_dispositions.H04_fail_closed: CONFIRMED: All forged inputs, corrupted states, and out-of-domain queries fail closed safely.
scientific_dispositions.H05_fallbacks_safe: CONFIRMED: Reference fallback preserves 100% agreement accuracy under all injected faults.
scientific_dispositions.H15_fixed_anchor: CONFIRMED: Anchor immutability eliminates floating drift risks.
scientific_dispositions.H18_finite_horizon: CONFIRMED: Atomic state commitment and strict boundary handling eliminate silent runtime drift.
scientific_dispositions.H23_sound_gate: CONFIRMED: Gate closed profile reliably enforces 0% false reuse on unsupported configurations.

limitations: Adversarial tests evaluate in-process software and numerical threat models; physical hardware attacks (bit-flips, hardware trojans) are outside the scope of software certificate verification.
